region.starter.landing.name: Landing
region.starter.landing.desc: The sheltered peninsula where the Founders came ashore: open plains, a forest belt and stone on the hills.
region.starter.westford.name: Westford
region.starter.westford.desc: The windswept shore north of the wide river, facing the open sea.
region.starter.northreach.name: Northreach
region.starter.northreach.desc: The northern headlands above the high moor.
region.starter.highmoor.name: Highmoor
region.starter.highmoor.desc: High grazing land below the crown, hiding coal and copper seams.
region.starter.crown.name: Crown
region.starter.crown.desc: The bare peaks at the roof of the island, snow in winter and stone all year.
region.starter.ironhills.name: Ironhills
region.starter.ironhills.desc: Rust-red hills in the east, rich with iron for a later age.
region.starter.farshore.name: Farshore
region.starter.farshore.desc: The far eastern shore, first to greet the sunrise.
region.starter.eastvale.name: Eastvale
region.starter.eastvale.desc: A broad vale beyond the narrow river, good soil waiting for the plough.
region.starter.marshlands.name: Marshlands
region.starter.marshlands.desc: Low, soggy ground that no builder can use until it is drained.
region.starter.shoals.name: Shoals
region.starter.shoals.desc: Shallow southern waters where the reef breaks the waves.
